title: Onairos Mobile
tagline: Port of Onairos App to Mobile, to utilize Filecoin and IPC for smooth UX to secure ML models on chain
description:
The Onairos app on web is an app which allows users to create their Digital Clones/Reflections. We train these models on their data, and secure and store these on the Blockchain, giving users full control over it's use and privacy.
Once created, other apps can ask for output data from the user models, and if the user agrees, we run ZKML inference and send the data over, rewarding the user in the process.
The users "Memory" data and Models are stored on Filecoin on mobile, for improved UX, less friction and better cost.
how_its_made: Onairos Mobile is built using flutter. The backend and training is done using node and pytorch respectively. And the models are stored on filecoin using lighthouse. We also make use of inhouse vectorDB and unique memory storage and store these on filecoin using lighthouse also. Distributed training in the future will be done using IPC, to reduce the number of access points we have to the users model. So we can soon train, run and store all the user models securely and privately on chain using filecoin (lighthouse) and IPC. The next evolution with decentralized inference is on our roadmap, and first prototype will be done using IPC
